meaning.en: To delete something means to remove or erase written material.

examples.en: Several lines had been deleted from her speech.

meaning.en: If someone is earnest, then they are honest.

examples.en: The child was very earnest when she told her mother how she broke the dish.

meaning.en: If something is ethnic, then it is related to a group with a similar culture.

examples.en: Many sections of the city are home to different ethnic communities.

meaning.en: To exclude someone means to not accept them into a group.

examples.en: Carol was excluded from the contest because her friend was a judge.

meaning.en: If something is firsthand, then it is from an original source.

examples.en: If you want firsthand knowledge, ask someone who saw it.

meaning.en: If someone is fluent in a language, then they are able to speak it very well.

examples.en: She was so fluent in German that you’d have thought she was from Germany.

meaning.en: If something is imperial, then it is related to an empire.

examples.en: These old imperial coins were once used in the Roman Empire.

meaning.vi: bao gồm tất cả, gồm cả, tính toàn bộ
meaning.en: If something is inclusive, then it is open to all groups and people in society.

examples.en: A more inclusive event would have allowed children to attend.

meaning.en: A legislature is the section of a government that makes laws.

examples.en: The senator had served ten years in the national legislature.

meaning.en: If something is linguistic, then it is concerned with language.

examples.en: A linguistic way of studying culture focuses on words within that culture.

meaning.vi: một ngôn ngữ mà thôi; đơn ngữ
meaning.en: If someone is monolingual, then they speak only one language.

examples.en: In today’s global economy, being monolingual limits your opportunities.

meaning.en: Nationality is an identity based on the nation from which you come.

examples.en: His nationality is German, but he speaks French, Spanish, and Korean.

meaning.en: A patriot is someone who loves, supports, and defends their country.

examples.en: Every year, young patriots join their countries’ militaries.

meaning.en: To prosecute someone means to take legal action against them.

examples.en: They were prosecuted for fishing in the river without a permit.

meaning.en: If something is racial, then it is related to a race or races.

examples.en: The differences between racial groups are physical characteristics and culture.

meaning.vi: nghiêm trang, nghiêm nghị, uy nghi
meaning.en: If something is solemn, then it is serious and honest.

examples.en: The professor preferred a solemn relationship between him and his students.

meaning.vi: sự đoàn kết, tình đoàn kết
meaning.en: Solidarity is a union formed from common responsibilities or interests.

examples.en: All the citizens came together in a show of solidarity to create change.

meaning.vi: sự khéo léo, tài xử trí
meaning.en: Tact is the ability to avoid offending people when dealing with problems.

examples.en: Since both sides would not agree, it required someone with tact to make peace.

meaning.vi: làm hao mòn, xói mòn, phá ngầm, đục khoét
meaning.en: To undermine someone means to betray them or weaken their efforts or authority.

examples.en: The documents helped to undermine the workers’ trust in their bosses’ honesty.

meaning.en: To constrain something means to limit its development.

examples.en: Jim cannot join us because he is constrained by previous plans.

meaning.vi: nhà ga (nhỏ), bến xe bus, kho hàng
meaning.en: A depot is a bus or train station.

examples.en: He waited for his mother to arrive at the depot.

meaning.vi: tích cực noi gương, làm theo
meaning.en: To emulate people means to imitate them because they are greatly admired.

examples.en: As a small boy, he always tried to emulate his big brother.

meaning.en: The forefinger is the finger between one’s thumb and middle finger.

examples.en: He shouted, “There it is!” and pointed with his forefinger.

meaning.vi: ruột, phá hủy bên trong, rút ruột
meaning.en: The guts are all the organs inside a person or animal.

examples.en: The doctor can tell you every process that happens in one’s guts.

meaning.en: When something is inherent, it is a natural part of something else.

examples.en: Sweating is an inherent bodily function when exercising.

meaning.en: To intimidate means to frighten others.

examples.en: My dad intimidates my friends whenever they visit.

meaning.vi: người gác cổng, người bảo vệ
meaning.en: A janitor is a person who makes repairs and takes care of a building.

examples.en: The school janitor cleaned up the messy cafeteria.

meaning.en: When something is moist, it is slightly wet.

examples.en: The ground is still moist from the rain last night.

meaning.en: Nope is an informal way of saying “no.”

examples.en: He asked if I had any money, and I had to say, “Nope.”

meaning.en: To prod means to push someone or something with a finger or pointed object.

examples.en: The bully prodded me in the chest with her finger.

meaning.en: A ransom is a sum of money paid to a kidnapper to set the person free.

examples.en: He kidnapped the prince and demanded $1 million as a ransom.

meaning.vi: ngăn cản, cản trở, kìm nén, kiềm chế
meaning.en: To restrain someone or something means to use physical strength to stop them.

examples.en: Mike restrained Allen from reaching the door.

meaning.en: Saliva is the watery liquid in people’s mouths that helps in digestion.

examples.en: The baby could not keep the saliva from dripping out of its mouth.

meaning.en: To spit means to force liquid from one’s mouth.

examples.en: He emerged from the pool and spit water from his mouth.

meaning.en: To sprint means to run very fast over a short distance.

examples.en: The kids didn’t want to be late to class, so they sprinted to the bus stop.

meaning.vi: trò quảng cáo, cuộc biểu diễn phô trương
meaning.en: A stunt is something that is done in order to get attention or publicity.

examples.en: The man jumped over the cars as a promotional stunt.

meaning.en: When people are tolerant, they are respectful of others’ rights and beliefs.

examples.en: The tolerant leader thought that everyone was equal regardless of race.

meaning.en: A vampire is a fictional monster that sleeps in a coffin and sucks people’s blood.

examples.en: The vampire snuck up on the woman and bit her neck.

meaning.en: To yawn means to open one’s mouth wide and breathe in air.

examples.en: The child yawned and stretched her arms before going to bed for the night.

meaning.en: If something is adjoining, it is next to or joined with a building or room.

examples.en: I couldn’t sleep because the people in the adjoining room were loud.

meaning.en: To allege something is to say that it is true without offering proof.

examples.en: The little girl had alleged that her older brother hid her favorite doll.

meaning.en: An arch is a curved opening formed under a structure such as a bridge or doorway.

examples.en: The arch of the bridge was not high enough for the tall boat to pass underneath.

meaning.vi: tập hợp, tụ tập, nhóm họp, lắp ráp
meaning.en: To assemble means to get together in one place.

examples.en: The parents assembled to discuss ways to improve their children’s education.

meaning.en: A casualty is a person killed or injured in a war or an accident.

examples.en: The only casualty in the car accident was a woman who broke her arm.

meaning.en: To erect something means to build it.

examples.en: The king erected two towers on the north and south sides of his castle.

meaning.en: If something is foul, then it is very unpleasant.

examples.en: He wouldn’t let his dog drink from the water because it had a foul smell.

meaning.en: A hectare is a unit of measure equal to 10,000 square meters.

examples.en: His family farm covered many hectares.

meaning.vi: tăng thêm, làm cao lên, nâng cao
meaning.en: To heighten an emotion means to increase the intensity of it.

examples.en: The pleasant music heightened their enjoyment of the wonderful dinner.

meaning.en: Hospitality is friendly behavior and entertainment, shown to guests or strangers.

examples.en: The travelers were amazed at the hospitality given them by the hotel’s staff.

meaning.en: A mansion is a large and expensive home.

examples.en: The mansion had thirty bedrooms, two kitchens, and a pool.

meaning.en: To outnumber a group means to have a greater number than it.

examples.en: The girls outnumbered the boys at the school by four to one.

meaning.en: If someone is overjoyed, then they are extremely happy.

examples.en: He was overjoyed by the news of his promotion.

meaning.en: A pasture is an area of land covered with grass for animals to use as food.

examples.en: The sheep were taken to a pasture where there was more grass.

meaning.en: A petition is a written request asking an authority to do something.

examples.en: The citizens all signed a petition asking the mayor to repair the sidewalks.

meaning.en: To renovate a building means to repair it, or to build new structures on it.

examples.en: The old fire station was renovated into an apartment building.

meaning.en: To revise something means to change it, or update it to make it better.

examples.en: When the editor discovered certain facts were wrong, he revised the book.

meaning.en: A slab is a large, thick, flat piece of stone, concrete, metal, or wood.

examples.en: I looked at various slabs of stone to decorate my house.

meaning.en: A terrace is an open area that is connected to a house or an apartment.

examples.en: In the afternoons, she liked to sit on the terrace and check her email.

meaning.en: Turf is a section of grass and the dirt in which it grows.

examples.en: After the game, the turf looked ragged.

meaning.en: If something is analogous to another thing, then it is like it in certain ways.

examples.en: The relationship with his teacher was analogous to that of a son and mother.

meaning.en: Binoculars are a device used for seeing things that are far away.

examples.en: He could see the ship on the horizon only if he used his binoculars.

meaning.en: The bulk of something is its size.

examples.en: The large elephant moved its bulk with legs as strong as tree trunks.

meaning.en: If something comprises something else, it consists of or is made up of it.

examples.en: Our school’s football team is mostly comprised with seniors.

meaning.en: To depict something means to show or portray it, often using art.

examples.en: The statue’s face depicted the general’s determination and courage.

meaning.en: If something is dual, then it is made up of two parts.

examples.en: The room had a dual function. It was a living room, but at night it was a bedroom.

meaning.en: Fahrenheit is a temperature scale where water freezes at 32° and boils at 212°.

examples.en: When the temperature dropped to 32° Fahrenheit, it started snowing.

meaning.en: To fulfill something means to achieve or finish it.

examples.en: The professor did not fulfill his promise not to miss a single class.

meaning.en: A grove is a small group of trees.

examples.en: All the trees in this grove are apple trees.

meaning.en: Ore is the raw form of rock or material from which a valuable metal is taken.

examples.en: The factory melted the ore and used it to make iron products.

meaning.en: The outback is the wild inland region of Australia where very few people live.

examples.en: Many Australian farmers use the outback to raise cattle.

meaning.vi: có nhiều giá trị hơn, có nhiều tác dụng hơn
meaning.en: To outweigh something means to exceed it in value, amount, or importance.

examples.en: Finding a warm place to sleep outweighed the need to find something to eat.

meaning.en: A paradox is a true statement or real event that seems illogical.

examples.en: The paradox of her work was that the less she worked, the more she got done.

meaning.en: A pier is a structure that extends into a body of water.

examples.en: If you want to catch bigger fish, then go to the far end of the pier.

meaning.en: A shortcut is a route that is shorter than the main route.

examples.en: We got to the house early because we took a shortcut through the forest.

meaning.en: A tariff is a tax or fee paid on certain imports or exports.

examples.en: Our tariff on imported wool makes foreign wool more expensive.

meaning.en: A thermometer is a device that measures temperature.

examples.en: The thermometer outside the window indicated that it was a hot day today.

meaning.en: To tilt something means to tip it into a sloping position.

examples.en: She tilted her glass and almost spilled some of the wine inside.

meaning.en: If a statement is vice versa, then its two main ideas are switched with one another.

examples.en: Students learn from their teachers, and vice versa.

meaning.en: The whereabouts of someone or something is the place where they are.

examples.en: The police looked for the lost dog, but its whereabouts were still unknown.
